title: HtmlNoscript
responsibility: Renders the native noscript element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlNoscript.attributes
inputs.description: Native noscript attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlNoscript.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native noscript element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlNoscript
outputs.description: The actual native noscript element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
